features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: You gain one of the following feature options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can replace the chosen option with the other one.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Prey
features.description: Once per turn when you deal damage to a creature marked by your Hunter's Mark, you can deal that spell's extra damage to a different creature you can see within 30 feet of the first creature and within the spell's range.

features.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
features.description: When you take damage, you can take a Reaction to give yourself Resistance to that damage and any other damage of the same type until the end of the current turn.
